items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: Yeah, I played with Clay Giles. ... Clay Giles learned me out of march.

ctx.x: No, he's dead now. Yeah. He's still living, huh? And so I've taken a couple of lessons with him. So finally, Giles was putting up a band, Clay Giles' brother. Well, after I learned, before that, I got a self-instructor. A fellow sent off to New York and got me a self-instructor. Well, I went on and I started practicing out to self-instructor. So at the time, I was in the pressing business, too, and still working where I'm at, where I just retired from.
